name: Ice Roller (1 N)
subtitle: For: Reducing Skin Puffiness  & Redness
metaDescription: Be Bodywise Ice Roller For Reducing Skin Puffiness  & Redness. It's 100% Safe, clinically tested. Order Now!

description:
Be Bodywise Ice Roller is here to refresh and relax your skin, giving you a perfect pick-me-up whenever needed!🧊

Use consistently for at least 3 months for best results
😁Reduces face and under-eye puffiness
🩸Boosts blood circulation
❤️Minimises redness
🧖‍♀️Tightens pores
🌟Soothes skin

Got hurt? You can use this tool to ice the affected area!

Step 1:Open the product and add water till 80% capacity. For better results, you can add rose petals or cucumber.
Step 2: Freeze in a freezer for a minimum of 4 hours 
Step 3: Once frozen, rinse under water and then open the cover
Step 4: Apply ice to the face in 30-second intervals and in circular motions

For best results, use it once a day for 3 months.

faqs.question: Does this come with a water inlet?
faqs.answer: Yes, it comes with an inlet for you to fill with water. You can put cucumber and rose petals inside and use the inlet to fill water.

faqs.question: Can I use it in the night?
faqs.answer: It is a perfect tool to soothe your skin, you can use it during the day and night
